About.Name: Falisha Hill
About.AboutText:
Hello, I am Falisha Hill. I am a mechanical engineering student with an interest in metal working and 3D digital designing. I am currently pursuing my undergraduate degree at Seattle Pacific University. I am interested in expanding my knowledge and experience in designing and building, as well as more technical skills such as coding and working with circuits.

I enjoy physical and creative challenges when it comes to engineering, and work well in a team and with individual assignments.
